notes: New shelf (no old kinds). Old k1 model list absorbed as archetypes: Wealden hall house, bastle house → British; Longère, Frutighaus, Geestharden, Uthland-Frisian, Upper Lusatian, Kulla, Vainakh tower (as residential ghala) → Continental; Masía (incl. Provençal mas), Cortijo, Finca, Casona, Trullo, Riad → Mediterranean; Charleston single house, chattel house, connected farm, upright and wing → Americas; Siheyuan, Yaodong, Assam-type → Asia. 'Bauernhaus' covered by Low German house and Black Forest house rather than a generic entry. Casona sourced via casa montañesa page; casa torre via Tower house; Cycladic house thinly sourced (Modern Greek architecture). No brands (maker-free patterns). Not added: Irish thatched cottage, Epirotic stone house, Scottish tower house (belongs in Castle & tower house). Link-detached house and mews from old k1 belong to the House types shelf, not here.
